title: Implicit Dynamical Tensor Train Approximation for Kinetic Equations with Stiff Fokker--Planck Collisions
summary: Low-rank methods for kinetic equations have attracted increasing attention due to their effectiveness in reducing the high dimensionality of phase space. In our previous work [G. Wang & J. Hu, J. Comput. Phys. 558 (2026) 114884], we developed a dynamical low-rank method based on the projector-splitting integrator in tensor-train (TT) format, in which explicit time integration is employed in all substeps.
